title: Irenaeus: Letter to Victor of Rome (fragments)
author: Irenaeus of Lyons
edition: Reliquiae Sacrae: Sive, Auctorum Fere Jam Perditorum Secundi Tertiique Saeculi Post Christum Natum Quae Supersunt. Martin Joseph Routh Oxford Oxford University Press 1846 2 Internet Archive

text_history.method: New English from the Greek copy-text; no published English used as wording.
